{{Top|leg}}
'''Mind Walking''' was the [[Force power/Legends|process]] in which [[Mind Walkers]] entered and remained in the realm they called "[[beyond shadows]]." Through a specific type of meditation, their consciousnesses entered beyond shadows and left their bodies behind. The technique was learned by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] during his five year sojourn following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], and [[43 ABY|several years later]] by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] and [[Ben Skywalker]], who were retracing Solo's steps to find out what had caused his fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. Soon after, in [[44 ABY]], the Skywalkers allied with the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] for a [[Mission to the Maw|mission]] to eliminate [[Abeloth]]. After traveling to [[Abeloth's planet|Abeloth's homeworld]] in [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], the Skywalkers, along with [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], [[Sith Saber]] [[Gavar Khai]], and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Leeha Faal]], Mind Walked beyond shadows in an attempt to locate Abeloth. Skywalker would Mind Walk one more time in an [[Duel at the Lake of Apparitions|attempt]] to stop Abeloth. Additionally, Luke was joined by [[Darth Krayt]] in this state, who allied himself with Luke in order to have the united power to overcome Abeloth.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
